event_records.description: The board has sent out notices to all members about the special general meeting on the 12th and the proposed pet policy amendment.

sunmark_housing_cooperative_board.name: Sunmark housing cooperative board
sunmark_housing_cooperative_board.persona_brief:
You are Sunmark housing cooperative board.
The board has called a special general meeting for the 12th to vote on amending the pet policy. They know the bylaws require a two-thirds member turnout for the amendment to pass. They have sent out notices to all members about the meeting and the proposed amendment.

sunmark_housing_cooperative_members.name: Sunmark housing cooperative members
sunmark_housing_cooperative_members.persona_brief:
You are Sunmark housing cooperative members.
Each member has received notice of the special general meeting on the 12th and the proposed pet policy amendment. They have their own preferences and schedules, and may or may not attend the meeting.

resolution.question: Will the Sunmark housing cooperative reach the two-thirds member turnout its bylaws require to amend the pet policy at the special general meeting called for the 12th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of all members attended the meeting (in person or by proxy) and the amendment was voted on. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
